neighbours.label: the token after a clause-opening 'For' that introduces a purpose or period ('For the privilege...', 'For 2020...')
fire: The rent was high. For the right to graze their sheep there, the shepherds paid a fee.
Sales were flat last year. For 2025, the board expects a modest recovery.
The castle had strict rules. For the honour of dining with the king, guests wore gloves.
The museum closed in March. For 2019, attendance had fallen by a third.
Housing was scarce. For the privilege of a room near the market, traders paid double.
Forecasts were cautious. For 2030, the agency predicts demand will peak.
The club was exclusive. For the right to fish the lake, members paid every spring.
Exports grew slowly. For 2024, the ministry projects a small surplus.
